name: fusion-omp
description: Fusion — run a hard question through an independent parallel model panel, then a judge synthesizes. An OMP skill + slash commands (installs on vanilla pi too; parallel fan-out is OMP-native).
author: Jordan Strauss

omp.name: fusion
omp.description: Independent parallel model panel -> judge synthesis. Ships the fusion skill + /fusion[-solo|-pair|-trio] commands. Uses the bundled `task` agent in plugin mode, so no custom-agent install is required. Configure panel/judge via modelRoles (fusion_panel_*/fusion_judge).
